zh-CN.title: 长按语音，实时转文字
items: 长按录音时实时显示识别文字，向左滑取消，向右滑转文字。
转写结果可编辑后放入输入框，也可继续发送语音。

en.title: Live transcription while recording
items: See words as you speak. Slide left to cancel or right to convert your recording to text.
Review and edit the transcript before adding it to your draft, or send the voice recording.
